items.title: Calif. Fines Afterpay $2.7 Million for Underwriting ‘Failures’
items.why: Expect state-level underwriting scrutiny of BNPL. Build ability-to-repay diligence into any embedded lending partner review.
items.summary_ai: California ordered Afterpay to pay about $2.68 million for failing to complete required ability-to-repay underwriting on loans made from 2020 to 2022.
items.take: Expect state-level underwriting scrutiny of BNPL. Build ability-to-repay diligence into any embedded lending partner review.

items.title: California hits BNPL lender Afterpay with $2.7m penalty
items.why: State enforcement is targeting BNPL underwriting, so vet ability-to-repay controls before embedding any BNPL partner.
items.summary_ai: California's DFPI fined Afterpay for skipping ability-to-repay underwriting on loans to new customers.
items.take: State enforcement is targeting BNPL underwriting, so vet ability-to-repay controls before embedding any BNPL partner.

items.title: California fines Afterpay $2.7M
items.why: BNPL ability-to-repay scrutiny is rising; build underwriting and affordability checks into diligence on any embedded BNPL partner.
items.summary_ai: California fined Afterpay $2.7M for failing to assess customers' ability to repay its BNPL loans.
items.take: BNPL ability-to-repay scrutiny is rising; build underwriting and affordability checks into diligence on any embedded BNPL partner.
